title: Compute cubic spin-lattice coupling coefficients for Al2O3:Fe3+
action: Using the free-ion Fe3+ parameters (B0=1130.22 cm^{-1}, C0=4111.45 cm^{-1}, xi_d0=588.946 cm^{-1}, <r^2>0=1.89039 a.u., <r^4>0=11.46485 a.u.), covalency reduction factor N=0.903, dipole parameter p=0.059 eR0, Trees correction alpha=43 cm^{-1}, reference distance R0=0.191 nm, and ligand charge q=-2e, evaluate the cubic spin-lattice coupling coefficients G11c and G44c from the point-charge-dipole model and the high-order perturbation formulas for d5 ions.

title: Transform to trigonal coefficients for Al2O3:Fe3+
action: Using the computed G11c and G44c, apply the coordinate rotation transformation to obtain the six trigonal spin-lattice coupling coefficients G11_t, G12_t, G13_t, G44_t, G14_t, G41_t.
description: Trigonal spin-lattice coupling coefficients for Al2O3:Fe3+ in cm^{-1}.
output_schema: Object with keys G11_t, G12_t, G13_t, G44_t, G14_t, G41_t (numeric values)

title: Compute cubic spin-lattice coupling coefficients for ZnSiF6·6H2O:Ni2+
action: Using the free-ion Ni2+ parameters scaled with covalency factor N=0.9 (B=1208 N^4, C=4459 N^4, xi_d=636 N^2, <r^2>=1.9804 N^2, <r^4>=13.4043 N^2), ligand charge q=-2e, distance R0=0.2048 nm, and the zero-order energy separations W_i for a d8 ion in octahedral symmetry obtained from the public reference (DOI:10.1103/PhysRevB.40.7292), evaluate the cubic spin-lattice coupling coefficients G11c and G44c from the high-order perturbation formulas for d8 ions.

title: Transform to trigonal coefficients for ZnSiF6·6H2O:Ni2+
action: Using the computed G11c and G44c, apply the same coordinate rotation transformation to obtain the six trigonal spin-lattice coupling coefficients G11_t, G12_t, G13_t, G44_t, G14_t, G41_t.
description: Trigonal spin-lattice coupling coefficients for ZnSiF6·6H2O:Ni2+ in cm^{-1}.
output_schema: Object with keys G11_t, G12_t, G13_t, G44_t, G14_t, G41_t (numeric values)
